title: Cat the Ripper: 13Ninme no Tanteishi
native_title: キャット・ザ・リパー ～１３人目の探偵士～
overview:
Whoa, I'm the murderer!?

You come to in a private detective's office and find the detective lying dead beside you. You search the office for clues, but two police officers confront you, and you are forced into hiding. Your only way out is to discover the true identity of the mysterious killer known as Cat the Ripper.

This 3D mystery adventure is based on 13-ninme no Tanteishi by mystery writer Masaya Yamaguchi.

- 3D mystery adventure for one player
- Shuttle Mouse compatible

わっ、私が殺人犯！？
